ch: Each time someone pays, tap Add a cost.
At the end, tap Settle up.
It works in dollars, Kenya shillings, pounds or euros.
What you see here is an example trip, a lake weekend with Maya, Tom, Grace and Sam.
To write down a cost, tap Add a cost at the bottom.
Only some people is for a cost not everyone shares.
When it is time to square up, tap Settle up.
Under the costs are four buttons: people and trip name, all my trips, start another…
How to start: tap Start my own trip.
Setting up Trip Tab takes about two minutes, before the trip.
Step four: each time someone pays for something, tap Add a cost.
Step seven: if a cost was wrong, tap it in the list to change it or take it off.
Step ten: when everyone is square, tap Finish this trip.
